races.paceDynamic: Fiorella Princess has a clear lead and will set a steady, uncontested pace through the early stages. Behind her, five horses (Hover On The Wind, Rebel Path, Over Spiced, Merrimack, Mick's Spirit) all want prominent positions, creating inevitable traffic problems and pace pressure from 2f out. The large hold-up contingent (Lion's House, Gogo Yubari, Sandscreendeliverd, Shalaa Asker, Spendmore Lane, Komorkis) will be relegated to the back but benefit from the developing speed battle ahead. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace will intensify late as the prominent runners clash, allowing closers to sweep past a tiring field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack pressures each other from halfway
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable as five horses vie for position behind Fiorella Princess, setting up perfect conditions for the hold-up brigade to strike. Sandscreendeliverd and Spendmore Lane can exploit their class advantage with late runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses can secure an ideal stalking position
scenarios.body: Hover On The Wind or Over Spiced finds the perfect pitch just behind the leaders and has enough left to resist the closers. Their recent 5f form and tactical speed give them the edge in a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fiorella Princess Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the lone leader gets an easy time of it early
scenarios.body: The pace battle behind her allows Fiorella Princess to dictate terms and she has enough in reserve to hold off late challenges. Her recent second at this trip suggests she can sustain the effort.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is slower than expected despite the numbers
scenarios.body: The prominent runners don't engage early enough, leaving too much to do in the final furlong against the natural speed of the leaders. Form horses with tactical pace edge out the hold-up horses.

races.paceDynamic: Age Of Time is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the outset, with Three On Thursday, Rusheen Boy and Hint Of The Jungle the only prominent runners to apply early pressure. The majority of this 16-runner field are hold-up horses who will settle towards the rear, creating a bunched finish behind what should be a sustainable early gallop. With 13 of 16 runners adopting hold-up tactics, the pace will be moderate early before intensifying dramatically in the final two furlongs as the field converges. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — they'll get the tempo they need and have plenty of cover in a large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Age Of Time sets uncontested fractions and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows the patient brigade to position perfectly and unleash finishing kicks when it matters. The sheer weight of numbers (13 hold-up runners) creates traffic problems but the best will find gaps and surge clear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Three On Thursday or Hint Of The Jungle press Age Of Time into a stronger gallop
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and prevents the hold-up brigade from closing effectively in the straight. Those tracking the pace inherit the perfect position to strike for home.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Age Of Time gets completely uncontested fractions and builds an unassailable lead
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of 13 runners backfire as nobody applies pressure early enough, allowing the leader to kick clear when the field finally moves. Age Of Time's consistent 7f form suggests he can sustain the effort.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates a cavalry charge finish with multiple hard-luck stories
scenarios.body: The 16-runner field becomes a lottery in the straight with fallers and interference allowing unfancied runners with clear passages to capitalise. Form goes out the window in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Age Of Time breaking smartly is crucial — if he misses the break, this race loses its only natural leader

races.paceDynamic: Lexington Jet and H Key Lails will set the early fractions, with both confirmed front-runners likely to contest the lead from the off. This setup moderately favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed — the pace is solid enough to bring stamina into play, but the two front-runners may not go fast enough early to completely set it up for the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate

scenarios.body: The honest gallop allows them to strike approaching the furlong pole when the leaders tire, with James Doyle's booking of Moonjid and Uniting's Ian Williams stable form (2/25) both suggesting confidence. These horses get first run on the field while avoiding the early battle.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: The leader gets into a rhythm and proves too tough to peg back, with Lexington Jet's recent hat-trick form and Alexandra Egan's 7lb claim providing the edge in a finish. The 15-runner field struggles to organize a serious challenge from mid-pack.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Strikes

scenarios.body: The field strings out badly and Commander Of Life or Tonal get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks. Tonal's recent course wins and Ryan Kavanagh's 5lb claim become decisive factors in a staying battle.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or one of the unfancied runners gets an uncontested run.
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically and a horse like My Boy Harry benefits from the 7lb claim and drops down from his recent shorter trip efforts. The competitive nature of handicaps allows for shock results when favorites underperform.

scenarios.trigger: If Veritable overcomes his layoff to contest or steal the lead
scenarios.body: The Gosden runner shows his class despite 107 days off, either outpacing Silver State early or picking up the pieces when the favourite fades. Luke Catton's 3lb claim proves crucial in a tight finish.
